Trace

AlpineReplay, Inc. · Austin, Texas, United States · founded 2010 · active · traceup.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Family or coach buys the devicePortable unitEvidence AUnder €500 to start

Trace lends a 1080p wide angle sideline camera on a 16 foot tripod for free and charges each family USD 180 to 300 a year for AI edited highlights of their own child, with the team's full game and a fixed livestream thrown in trace-01, trace-05.

For American youth soccer parents who want their child's moments cut automatically and sent to their phone, and club directors who want video for every team without a capital budget trace-01, trace-08. It is not sold in Europe and the pricing is in US dollars only trace-01, trace-05.

Trace exists because its founders, who started with the AlpineReplay ski tracking app in 2010, realised the person who will pay for youth sports video is the parent, so they gave the camera away and sold the child's highlights trace-03, trace-01. It matters now because the free camera model, backed by USD 65 million of venture money and state association deals such as Florida and Eastern Pennsylvania in 2026, has pushed the effective price of a team camera in the United States toward zero trace-03, trace-08. It also shows the cost of that model, a Trustpilot score of 1.6 driven by billing, cancellation and download restrictions, which tells you the money is made in the fine print, with the hardware as bait trace-04.

Price band USD 0 camera lease (USD 99 one off if paying monthly) + USD 180/yr Basic or USD 300/yr Pro per family; monthly USD 25 or USD 40 trace-01

Italy Trace publishes US dollar pricing only, ships from a US warehouse and names no European availability, and no Italian retailer, reseller or club deployment was found trace-01, trace-05.

Products

  • TraceCam with PlayerFocus (camera). 1080p wide angle AI camera on a 16 foot tripod, leased free with a subscription, records the full field and derives per player views trace-01, trace-09.
  • Trace Teams app (app). Manager app for jersey setup, recording control and livestream link sharing trace-11, trace-07.
  • PlayerFocus Basic and Pro (platform). Family subscriptions delivering personalised highlights, PlayerCam, full game and tactical highlights, with Pro adding analytics, downloads and playlists trace-01.
  • Trace iD (add-on). Public shareable player profile with downloadable content for recruiting trace-09, trace-10.
  • MultiCam (add-on). Smartphone angles from parents synced to the main recording trace-05.
  • Livestream (beta) (add-on). Fixed wide shot streamed over a hotspot, free to viewers with a Trace account trace-07.

Scale, company-stated

Over 1,000 clubs and 1.4 million athletes with camera access in April 2022 trace-03. Trace states it captures over a million highlights a week from thousands of games, April 2026 trace-08. Crunchbase lists 51 to 100 employees trace-02.

2025 and 2026

  • 2026-03-06: Eastern Pennsylvania Youth Soccer announces Trace partnership trace-15.
  • 2026-04-08: Florida Youth Soccer and Trace launch free camera initiative with code FYSAFREE trace-08.
  • 2026: Trustpilot reviews through September 2026 continue to cite renewals, activation failures and download limits trace-04.
